title: Animal Conversations episode input

audioFile.description: Run-relative copy of the user-supplied audio file.

speaker.description: Provisional value until confirmed against the user-audio beat by the speaker-review workflow.

caption.description: Complete spoken line for this beat. The renderer automatically presents it as progressive one-to-three-word caption cards.

bounceAt.description: Optional explicit emphasis events, expressed as strictly increasing second offsets from this beat's start. Omit for neutral talking, which uses mouth motion only.

timingRules: the final beat ends within 0.08 seconds of measured user-audio duration
each beat stores the complete spoken line; the renderer, not the operator, splits it into progressive one-to-three-word caption cards
every beat speaker is explicitly confirmed before validation through direct audio, a user label, a checksum-matched documented reference video, or silence
speaker confirmation becomes stale whenever the audio, timing, caption, camera, or speaker assignment changes
neutral talking has mouth motion only; vertical bounce occurs only at an explicit bounceAt emphasis event
bounceAt contains no more than two strictly increasing offsets inside its beat
